description: She wears a floor-length deep green fitted dress and layered overdress with a low square neckline and elbow-length outer sleeves. Gold-brown woven knotwork borders frame the neckline, shoulder strips, sleeve ends, long front and hem. Two round brooch fittings decorate the shoulders and a narrow patterned belt has a round buckle. A cream underdress appears at the lower front and sleeves. A dark green and brown checked woven wrap with fringed edges rests along both forearms and hangs at the sides. Brown closed shoes show below the hem. All principal layers are opaque, with upper chest exposed and bust, abdomen, hips and pelvis covered. Actual textile fibers are uncertain.
